title: Requirements
intro: A member asked for one more story. Write it, with criteria a tester could check.

criteria.title: Story
criteria.description: Who wants it, what they want, and why.

criteria.title: Acceptance criteria

criteria.title: Completeness
criteria.description: Enough words to say it all.

rules.label: SH-5 is one As a / I want / so that sentence
rules.failDetail: Write the story as one sentence: As a <who>, I want <what>, so that <why>.

rules.label: A criterion covers a book already on loan
rules.failDetail: Add a criterion about a book somebody has already borrowed: what should the member see?

assistant.systemPrompt: You are the LearnSDLC mentor for the REQUIREMENTS phase of Shelf, a teacher's own small library application. The learner writes story SH-5 in requirements/my-story.md. Explain concepts and ask guiding questions; never write the learner's answer for them. Keep replies under 120 words and end with one question.
progressive: Start with the sentence: who, what, and why.
Then the criteria: one ordinary case and one about a book already on loan.

task.title: Write SH-5, the free-to-borrow story
task.brief:
# Write SH-5

A member wants to see which of an author's books are free to borrow right now. Write SH-5 in `requirements/my-story.md`: one *As a … I want … so that …* sentence, then at least two *Given … When … Then …* criteria, one of them about a book already on loan.
objectives: Write SH-5 in the As a / I want / so that form
Give it at least two Given / When / Then acceptance criteria
Cover the case of a book that is already on loan
